info.title: Every Inn Agent Core — AdminApi (staff API)
info.description: Provider-owned contract of everyinn-agent-core (ADR-013/014). Reachable ONLY through the Service Binding `{ service: everyinn-agent-core(-dev), entrypoint: AdminApi }` held by everyinn-admin — the public workers.dev URL serves only /health and /webhooks/*. Headers: X-EI-Caller: admin-bff, X-EI-Actor-Id (digits), X-EI-Actor-Role (manager|receptionist), X-EI-Actor-Name (URI-encoded). Door codes are never logged; plaintext only on reveal=1 endpoints. Errors: { error: { code, message, request_id, details? } }. Responses are Cache-Control: private, no-store.

servers.description: Service Binding (AdminApi entrypoint) — not a public host

x-callers-legend.admin-bff: Admin BFF (everyinn-admin) — the only caller of AdminApi

get.summary: Liveness (also on the public export).
Persona, model, quiet/busy hours, rules, tool switches (ETag).

put.summary: Patch settings (unknown keys rejected). expectedVersion required.

post.summary: Instant busy toggle: exactly one of minutes (15..720), until (≤24h), off.

get.summary: Gate codes (newest first) + 6 lockboxes; masked unless reveal=1.

post.summary: New gate code. Without validUntil it becomes current from validFrom and closes open-ended codes.

put.summary: Set the fixed lockbox code of a room (OD-4).

get.summary: Resolution (override → vault gate → missing; lockbox) for a stay; plaintext only with reveal=1.

delete.summary: Remove the override (fall back to the vault).

get.summary: Nav badge counts (ETag = inbox version).
Keyset page (30) by last message; filter all|pending|ai|human (ETag on first page).

parameters.name: ads
parameters.description: Only conversations that came from an ad / referral

get.summary: Detail (phone revealed) + latest 30 messages oldest-first; marks read.

delete.summary: Manager only. Erase one guest's conversation (data-deletion request): messages, AI runs, escalations, echo bookkeeping. 409 ESCALATION_PENDING while an escalation is pending.

post.summary: Staff takes over; AI silent for takeover_minutes.
Hand the conversation back to the AI.
Staff replies directly to the guest (sandbox in AR-1).

get.summary: 'AI đang nghĩ gì' — latest 10 brain turns (route, tools, RAG chunk ids, tokens, neurons). Never door codes.

AI-9 'Truy vết AI': brain turns newest first (30 per page, keyset `before` = createdAt). Filters: conversationId, route, problem=1 (guard / error / auto hand-off). Guest text redacted (door codes, phones).

AI-9: one brain turn with its step trace — input / output / ms of every step (stage, scenario, sales, LLM rounds, tools, guard, template, reply). Door codes scrubbed, phones masked, values cut to 2 KB; steps null for turns older than 30 days or before migration 0014.

post.summary: Staff chats as a test guest. Default: 202 + turn.status=queued, the brain runs in the background (poll the conversation). wait=true runs synchronously (tests/simulator).

imageUrl.description: Optional guest photo: https:// link or data:image/(jpeg|png|webp);base64 (≤ 1.5 MB). With a photo, text may be empty.

post.summary: Supervised mode: send the AI draft (optionally edited).

get.summary: Owner escalations by status (default pending) or the pending ones of a conversation.

post.summary: confirm_deposit|confirm_full (CONFIRM_HOLD_PAYMENT → Booking Core confirm with THIS staff member as actor, idempotent), reject, resolve.

get.summary: OD-5 delivery schedules by status (default reminded).
Ready-to-paste check-in text WITH codes for manual sending (OD-5b). text=null + missing[] when a code is missing.

post.summary: Owner sent the check-in message manually.

get.summary: RAG documents (metadata).

post.summary: Add a .md/.txt knowledge document (422 SECRET_IN_KNOWLEDGE if it looks like it contains a door code).

get.summary: Document incl. raw content.

put.summary: Edit a document (expectedVersion). Content/title edits reset status to pending.

delete.summary: Delete a document, its chunks and vectors.

post.summary: Chunk (~800 chars) + embed (bge-m3) + upsert into Vectorize.

get.summary: Exact FAQ answers used by the pre-router (no LLM).

post.summary: Door-code resolution for up to 20 stays (daily roster). Plaintext only with reveal=true.

get.summary: Detail + 30 latest messages + escalations + last AI runs in one call; weak ETag on the inbox version (304 when nothing changed). Marks read.

put.summary: Internal note (≤ 1000 chars); never sent to the guest or the LLM.

get.summary: Accent-insensitive search over guest names / handles / phones and message text (FTS5).
Portal labels (OD-12).

delete.summary: Manager only; removes it from every conversation.

get.summary: AI-7 W4: collection schemas (fields, options resolved), capabilities, enums and template sample values — the admin renders lists and forms from it.

post.summary: Renders template variants with sample (or given) values.

get.summary: Every row of a collection (incl. inactive), sorted.

post.summary: Create a custom row (manager). Validated against the registry.

put.summary: Partial update with expectedVersion (manager). System rows keep their locked fields.

delete.summary: Delete a custom row (manager); system rows → 409 SYSTEM_ROW (switch them off).

get.summary: Guest personas (segment, stats, tags, note), newest first, max 100.

put.summary: Owner tags + note of a guest (expectedVersion); the segment is recomputed on the next message.

get.summary: Learning view: decisions per capability × segment over N days + delegation suggestions.

depositMinLeadDays.description: OD-25: a deposit is offered only when check-in is at least this many days away; otherwise full payment (a guest asking for a deposit → DEPOSIT_EXCEPTION card).

metaAccess.description: AR-2: who the AI answers on Facebook/Instagram. allowlist (default, nobody) ignores every other sender before anything is stored; open = everyone (owner-approved cutover only).

visionModelId.description: Workers AI model for turns where the guest sent photos (vision + tools). Default @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it.

guestSeenAt.description: Guest read our messages up to this time (Meta read receipts).

deletedAt.description: Set when the guest unsent the message (text is then empty).

reaction.description: Emoji the guest put on this message.
